name: Deja Vu
source:
In this kinetic visual novel, you play as Gwen, an office worker at Pendragon Corporations. Navigate your feelings for your coworker and boss while glimpsing the past and future.

[From [url=https://ilanaf.itch.io/deja-vu]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在这部动感视觉小说中，你扮演格温，潘德拉贡公司的一名办公室职员。在回顾过去和未来的同时，了解你对同事和老板的感受。

[来自[url=https://ilanaf.itch.io/deja-vu]Itch.io[/url]]
